item.frontierhunts.snowmobile.desc1: A two-up mountain sled: it glides over the snow and climbs the mountainsides, and only runs on snow or ice. Runs on gasoline: pour a jerry can into it.
item.frontierhunts.snowmobile.desc2: Forward: throttle · Back: brake, then reverse · Left/right: steer. Break it (a few hits) to get the item back.
hint.frontierhunts.snowmobile.ride: Use: ride (two seats) · Jerry can: refuel · Break it to pick it up
message.frontierhunts.snowmobile_no_fuel: The engine turns over but won't catch: the tank is dry. Use a jerry can on it.
message.frontierhunts.snowmobile_out_of_: Out of gas: the engine dies.
hint.frontierhunts.snowmobile.no_snow: A snowmobile only runs on snow or ice: the track has nothing to grip here.
